description: Returns the commentary on a verse or passage (Rashi, Ramban, Ibn Ezra, Sforno and others), in each commentator's own words, with links. Can be limited to named commentators.

commentators.description: Optional list of commentator names to filter by, e.g. ['Rashi','Ramban']. If omitted, returns all commentary.

name: fetch_commentary
title: Read commentary on a passage
